'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Mark VanDriel DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark VanDriel]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Maven
* '''Deck name:''' This deck title is not clever
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
